anya: quick update — spun up magpie-embed-lite (FP16 -> int8 per-channel) on staging, ran wiki holdout recall@k suite. seeing a weird cluster collapse for policy/legal topics and a sizable recall drop.

lucas: can you paste the eval numbers?

anya: eval-bot: (auto) run 2026-03-18 14:12 UTC
```
Model: magpie-embed-lite
Config: int8_per_channel=True, qtype=asymmetric, calibrate=global
Recall@1: fp16=0.78 -> int8=0.65 (-16.7%)
Recall@5: fp16=0.88 -> int8=0.77 (-12.5%)
Recall@10: fp16=0.92 -> int8=0.86 (-6.5%)
Silhouette (kmeans k=50): fp16=0.42 -> int8=0.21
Notes: cluster tightness collapsed around several high-frequency tokens.
```

devon: yikes. silhouette halved. could be calibration floor or per-channel clamp gone wrong.

simon: also try per-tensor symmetric quant as a quick sanity check. which kernel are we running?

anya: using our custom cuda-q8 kernel with per-channel clamp. i can repro locally with a tiny subset. starting a per-tensor symmetric run now.

lucas: also double-check L2 normalization step pre/post-quant. i've seen scala mismatches where dequantized vectors end up tiny.

anya: good call — found a few vectors with norm ~3e-4 after dequant. dumping one pair for debugging:
```
FP16 vec (first 8): [0.121, -0.034, 0.443, -0.002, 0.007, 0.221, 0.0, 0.013]
INT8 dequant (first 8): [1.2e-4, -3.4e-5, 4.4e-4, -2e-6, 7e-6, 2.2e-4, 0.0, 1.3e-5]
```

devon: that looks like a scale/overflow issue — calibrator probably picked a huge scale due to an outlier or used min-max across mixed distributions. try re-running calibration with a 1e-5 floor and per-channel hist bins (kld).

anya: launching calibration sweep (per-channel kld, per-tensor symmetric, min-floor=1e-5) — 3 runs: quick/medium/full. will post outputs.

eval-bot: sweep started: job id magpie-int8-sweep-20260318-01

simon: if sweep doesn't recover, fallback = serve fp16 for high-recall routes and int8 for low-cost routes + routing policy based on route tags. also consider raising index nlist or HNSW ef to mask quality loss.

anya: agreed. as a mitigation i'm going to try: 1) per-tensor symmetric, 2) calibrator floor, 3) reindex with nlist=16384 and ef_search=128 for the affected holdout.

lucas: jot down experiment matrix so we can correlate which factor helps most.

anya: will dump a short CSV after runs. thanks — will update thread once sweep finishes :thumbsup:
